## Evidence and safety

- [ ] Device/API semantics and data origin are documented.
- [ ] Missing, malformed, and relevant API-error cases are tested.
- [ ] Cloud request impact is assessed.
- [ ] Diagnostics and fixtures contain no sensitive data.
- [ ] New user-facing text exists in English and German.
- [ ] Writable behavior validates capabilities and confirms read-back.
- [ ] Foreign code provenance and license notices are documented, or no foreign code was used.
- [ ] Changelog and user documentation are updated where applicable.
